title: Screen controls and usability
summary: Feedback on the screen and its controls centers on ease of use, with praise for the display and simple controls but criticism of confusing menus, sluggish responses, and awkward touchscreen use while driving.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the new screen for looking better and the screen controls for being simple and convenient to use.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the screen functions as confusing, sluggish, and awkward to operate by touch while driving.

mixed.summary: The mixed review says the new display screen is confusing and hard to get used to while comparing it unfavorably with an older model.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention screen-related learning time, menu behavior, and reliance on the main screen, but the examples are insufficient to assign a clear overall sentiment consistently.

limitations: Many topic reviews are undetermined, so the sentiment picture is incomplete.
The sampled fragments include adjacent issues such as steering wheel audio controls and heater controls that connect to main-screen reliance, which broadens the topic beyond the display alone.
Examples are limited and stratified rather than representative, so they show observed themes without indicating how common each issue is overall.
